verdict.rationale: LobeHub publishes its own API reference: a public REST API documented through an OpenAPI specification (the probe confirms openapi.json returns HTTP 200) and an SDK generated from that spec. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples, so only the reference part of the story is supported. missing for 10: an interactive explorer (try-it console), runnable request examples, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Integrate through HTTP | [OpenAPI specification]... Use the public REST API, authentication, and parameters supported by the target deployment.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://lobehub.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
`@lobehub/sdk` is generated from OpenAPI. Follow the matching README and specification for methods, authentication, and streaming.
